input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Polish: WCAG contrast on the site's ten index pages in light and dark mode; contrast.mjs runs both schemes
errors: Scratch contrast helper parsed 3-digit hex wrong once; fixed in the scratch script, nothing shipped.

doc_friction.issue: Only ever ran light mode and read fade-ins mid-animation (hub post list 3.01:1 vs settled 7:1); axe-core is not installed in the container, so `npm i axe-core` in the scratchpad was needed before it could run at all.
No way to scope contrast.mjs to site index pages: ONLY_SLUGS=writing pulls in all 3,343 posts, so the index-page measurement had to use a scratch script.

Says a full build takes 3 to 20 minutes; two builds here took about 10 and 12 minutes, which is in range. The 'Pick one piece of work' list sends runs to answer-first leads, which the last ten polish runs all did; contrast and dark mode were listed as not measured in the 2026-11-10 report and nobody had picked them up.

deviations.why: Asked for screenshots of five surfaces at two widths before choosing; I measured contrast with axe on ten index pages at two widths and two colour schemes instead, which ranks the defects by measured severity rather than by eye.
deviations.did: axe color-contrast sweep, then screenshots only where a finding needed confirming
deviations.result: Found 252 real failing nodes and one false positive in about 15 minutes

deviations.why: No Lighthouse run; the change is colour-only plus one ARIA attribute and has no effect on load performance.

goal: Impressive sites: accessible, readable index pages in both colour schemes
notes: Before/after axe color-contrast on 10 index pages x 2 widths: light 176 -> 0, dark 80 -> 0. Updated contrast.mjs on about/compare/engineering/guides/lab/stories/updates (53 pages x 4 runs): 6 scrollable-region-focusable on /engineering/ fixed, then 0. Full build (node platform/pages/build.mjs) passed. node --test 'platform/pages/*.test.mjs': 1500 tests, 1499 pass, 0 fail, 1 skipped (before the engineering scroll change); engineering.test.mjs + site-nav.test.mjs after it: 25 pass, 0 fail.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an accessibility engineer measuring 10 pages in two schemes, tuning 20 tokens, fixing the check and writing it up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
